# Arc

> Diagrams as code. Arc turns typed, diffable config (JSON/TypeScript) into clean, themeable architecture diagrams.
> Canonical site: https://arc.jdi.sh · Docs: https://arc.jdi.sh/docs · Source: https://github.com/arach/arc

## Packages

- @arach/arc: full editor + ArcDiagram renderer (React). Peers: react, react-dom, lucide-react
- @arach/arc-viewer: native renderers: ArcMermaidPlayer, ArcMermaid, parseMermaid, importMermaid
- @arach/arc-iso: isometric renderer (React, plus vanilla renderToElement/renderToString)
- @arach/arc-editor: editor app (npx @arach/arc-editor)

## Key Facts

- Diagram model: ArcDiagramData (layout, nodes, nodeData, connectors, connectorStyles)
- Renderer: ArcDiagram component, prop `data`
- 8 themes: default, warm, cool, mono, engineering, workbench, tactical, command (command is the Arc editor default; the component prop falls back to default)
- 8 logical node colors: violet, emerald, blue, amber, sky, zinc, rose, orange
- Node sizes: xs, s, m, l
- Editor route: /editor (React Router; /editor/:sessionId for saved sessions). The #data= hash is only for embed payloads, not the editor
- Player/embed route: /player/*
- Toolchain: bun (bun run dev, bun run build, bun run lint, bun run typecheck)

## Recent Capabilities

- Native Mermaid sequenceDiagram rendering in @arach/arc-viewer (no mermaid dependency)
- importMermaid: lossy Mermaid flowchart/state import with warnings/unsupported diagnostics
- Declarative group layout via layoutHints (GroupLayoutHint)
- Focus stories: guided diagram walkthroughs (FocusStep, focusTargets, showFocusStory)

## Repo Entry Points

- src/main.tsx: React entry
- src/App.tsx: routes (/, /editor, /player/*, /docs, /blog/native-mermaid-sequences, /iso-demo, /iso-examples, /iso-interactive, /inspiration)
- src/components/ArcDiagram.tsx: ArcDiagram renderer
- src/components/editor/: editor (DiagramEditor.tsx, EditorProvider.tsx, editorReducer.ts, InspectorPanel.tsx)
- src/utils/: themes.ts, constants.ts, iconRegistry.ts, fileOperations.ts
- docs/: Markdown source for the docs pages above
